choose.otherwise: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_member m WHERE m.case_id = c.id AND m.user_id = #{userId})

mapper.select:
SELECT c.case_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM case_main c WHERE c.deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.case_type

SELECT c.status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM case_main c WHERE c.deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM case_main c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.treatment_amount), 0) FROM case_injury_ext e JOIN case_main c ON c.id = e.case_id WHERE c.deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.award_amount), 0) FROM case_arbitration_ext e JOIN case_main c ON c.id = e.case_id WHERE c.deleted = 0
SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(c.close_date, c.occur_date)) FROM case_main c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.close_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done FROM deadline_reminder d JOIN case_main c ON c.id = d.case_id WHERE c.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'PENDING' AND t.deadline < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue FROM task t JOIN case_main c ON c.id = t.case_id WHERE t.deleted = 0

SELECT c.case_type AS caseType, c.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS value FROM case_main c WHERE c.deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.case_type, c.status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_main c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.close_date IS NOT NULL AND c.close_date >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(CURDATE()), 1)

SELECT d.id AS id, d.case_id AS caseId, c.case_no AS caseNo, c.employee_name AS employeeName, d.node_name AS nodeName, d.deadline_date AS deadlineDate, d.status AS status, c.handler_id AS handlerId, c.status AS caseStatus, c.case_type AS caseType FROM deadline_reminder d JOIN case_main c ON c.id = d.case_id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND d.status <> 'DONE'
ORDER BY d.deadline_date ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.case_type = 'INJURY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS injuryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.case_type = 'ARBITRATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS arbitrationCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.plant_area IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.plant_area) <> '' THEN c.plant_area END) AS areaCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.case_id IS NOT NULL AND (e.recognize_result IS NULL OR e.recognize_result IN ('NOT_DECLARED', 'DECLARING')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS waitRecognize, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.case_id IS NOT NULL AND (e.appraisal_level IS NULL OR TRIM(e.appraisal_level) = '' OR e.appraisal_level = '—') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS waitAppraisal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.case_id IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(e.subsidy_disability_status, '') <> 'RECEIVED' OR COALESCE(e.subsidy_medical_status, '') <> 'RECEIVED' OR COALESCE(e.subsidy_employment_status, '') <> 'RECEIVED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaid FROM case_main c LEFT JOIN case_injury_ext e ON e.case_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.case_type IN ('INJURY', 'ARBITRATION')
